_doc: Quantities are for 4 servings. kind: lauk (main) | sayur (veg side) | onepot (replaces rice+lauk+sayur). protein: chicken | beef | mutton | fish | seafood | egg | tofu | veg. spicy: 0 none, 1 mild, 2 pedas. All dishes are halal. NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW: generated drafts.

recipes.name: Ayam masak merah
recipes.en: Chicken in spiced tomato chili sauce
steps: Rub chicken with salt and a little turmeric, fry until golden, set aside
Blend soaked dried chili, shallots, garlic and ginger
Fry cinnamon and star anise, add the paste and cook until oil separates
Add tomato sauce, sliced tomato, santan and sugar, then the chicken and sliced onion. Simmer 10 minutes

recipes.name: Ayam masak kicap
steps: Fry chicken and potato wedges until lightly browned, set aside
Fry pounded garlic and ginger with cinnamon and star anise
Add both soy sauces, a cup of water, sugar and salt
Return chicken and potato, simmer until thick. Add sliced onion at the end

recipes.name: Ayam goreng berempah
steps: Blend shallots, garlic, ginger and lemongrass
Marinate chicken with the paste, turmeric, chili powder and salt for at least 30 minutes
Deep fry on medium heat until cooked through
Fry curry leaves in the same oil and scatter over

recipes.name: Kari ayam
steps: Mix curry powder with a little water into a thick paste
Fry sliced onion, garlic, ginger, whole spices and curry leaves
Add curry paste and cook until fragrant and oily
Add chicken, potato and 2 cups water. Simmer 25 minutes, then add santan and salt

recipes.name: Ayam masak lemak cili api
recipes.en: Chicken in turmeric coconut gravy with bird's eye chili
steps: Pound chili padi, shallots, garlic and ginger with turmeric
Boil the paste with bruised lemongrass in 1 cup water
Add chicken and potato, cook 20 minutes
Add santan and salt, simmer gently without boiling hard

recipes.name: Ayam kurma
steps: Mix kurma powder with water into a paste
Fry whole spices, sliced onion, garlic and ginger
Add paste, then chicken and potato with 1.5 cups water
Simmer 25 minutes, add santan, tomato wedges and salt

recipes.name: Ayam halia
steps: Marinate chicken pieces with light soy, sesame oil and cornflour
Fry ginger strips until golden and fragrant
Add chicken and stir-fry until sealed
Add oyster sauce, dark soy, sugar and half a cup water. Cook covered 10 minutes, toss in spring onion

recipes.name: Ayam masam manis
steps: Coat chicken cubes in egg, then flour and cornflour. Fry until crisp
Fry onion, capsicum and tomato for a minute
Add both sauces, sugar, salt and half a cup water. Thicken with a little cornflour
Toss the chicken in the sauce just before serving

recipes.name: Ayam kung pao
recipes.en: Kung pao chicken with dried chili and peanuts
steps: Marinate diced chicken with light soy and cornflour
Toast peanuts in a dry pan, set aside
Fry cut dried chili, garlic and ginger, then the chicken on high heat
Add sauces, sugar and onion. Toss in peanuts

recipes.name: Ayam lada hitam
steps: Marinate chicken with cornflour and a little oyster sauce
Fry garlic and coarsely crushed black pepper
Add chicken and cook until done
Add sauces, onion and capsicum, splash of water. Cook 2 minutes

recipes.name: Sup ayam
steps: Fry pounded onion, garlic and ginger with soup spice
Add chicken and 1.5 litres water, bring to boil
Add potato and carrot, simmer 25 minutes
Season, add tomato and spring onion at the end

recipes.name: Tom yam ayam
steps: Boil 1.2 litres water with bruised lemongrass and tom yam paste
Add chicken, cook 15 minutes
Add cabbage, onion, tomato and chili padi
Season with fish sauce and sugar, finish with lime juice off the heat

recipes.name: Daging masak kicap
steps: Boil thinly sliced beef in a little water until tender, keep the stock
Fry garlic, ginger and half the onion
Add beef, stock and soy sauces, cook until thick
Add remaining onion rings, tomato and sliced chili

recipes.name: Rendang daging
steps: Blend soaked dried chili, shallots, garlic, ginger, galangal and lemongrass
Fry the paste until dark and oily
Add beef, santan and 1 cup water. Simmer uncovered, stirring often
Cook about 2 hours until the gravy is almost dry. Season with sugar and salt

recipes.name: Kari daging
steps: Fry whole spices, onion, garlic, ginger and curry leaves
Add curry paste, fry until oily
Add beef and 3 cups water, simmer 60 minutes
Add potato, cook until soft, then santan and salt

recipes.name: Sup daging
steps: Boil beef with pounded onion, garlic, ginger and soup spice in 1.5 litres water
Simmer 60 minutes until tender
Add potato and carrot, cook 20 minutes
Season and finish with spring onion

recipes.name: Kari kambing
steps: Fry fennel, whole spices and curry leaves, then onion, garlic and ginger
Add curry paste and tomato, cook until oily
Add mutton and 3 cups water, simmer 60 minutes
Add potato and cook until tender. Season

recipes.name: Ikan goreng kunyit
steps: Clean fish and score both sides
Rub with turmeric and salt, rest 10 minutes
Fry in hot oil until crisp on both sides

recipes.name: Asam pedas ikan
steps: Blend soaked dried chili, shallots, garlic, ginger and belacan
Fry the paste with lemongrass until oily
Add tamarind water (about 3 cups) and bring to boil
Add fish, okra and tomato. Simmer 10 minutes, season with salt and sugar

recipes.name: Gulai lemak ikan
steps: Pound chili padi, shallots, garlic, ginger and turmeric
Boil the paste with lemongrass and 1 cup water
Add santan and okra, simmer 5 minutes
Add fish and a little tamarind water, cook gently 8 minutes

recipes.name: Kari ikan
recipes.en: Fish curry with okra and brinjal
steps: Fry curry leaves, onion, garlic and ginger
Add fish curry paste, fry until oily
Add tamarind water, brinjal and okra, cook 8 minutes
Add fish, tomato and santan. Simmer 8 minutes

recipes.name: Ikan masak kicap
recipes.en: Fried fish in sweet soy sauce
steps: Salt and fry the fish until crisp, set aside
Fry garlic and ginger, add kicap and half a cup water
Add onion, chili and tomato, cook 2 minutes
Pour over the fish or toss gently

recipes.name: Siakap stim limau
recipes.en: Steamed sea bass with lime and chili
steps: Steam the fish on lemongrass for 12 to 15 minutes
Mix chopped garlic, chili padi, lime juice, fish sauce and sugar with a little hot water
Pour the sauce over the fish, top with spring onion

recipes.name: Tilapia masam manis
steps: Salt and deep fry the fish until crisp
Fry onion, then add both sauces, sugar and half a cup water
Add tomato and cucumber, thicken with cornflour
Pour the sauce over the fish

recipes.name: Sambal udang
steps: Blend soaked dried chili, shallots, garlic and belacan
Fry the paste slowly until dark and oily
Add tamarind water, sugar and salt
Add prawns and onion rings, cook 4 minutes

recipes.name: Udang masak lemak cili api
steps: Pound chili padi, shallots, garlic and turmeric
Boil with lemongrass and half a cup water
Add santan, bring to a gentle simmer
Add prawns, cook 4 minutes, season

recipes.name: Sotong sambal
steps: Blend soaked dried chili, shallots and garlic
Fry the paste until oily, add tamarind water, sugar and salt
Add squid rings and onion
Cook only 3 to 4 minutes so the squid stays tender

recipes.name: Sambal ikan bilis
steps: Fry ikan bilis and peanuts separately until crisp, set aside
Blend soaked dried chili, shallots and garlic, fry until oily
Add tamarind water, sugar and onion rings
Toss back half the ikan bilis. Serve the rest and peanuts on top

recipes.name: Telur dadar
steps: Beat eggs with chopped onion, chili, spring onion and salt
Fry in hot oil, flip once when the edges are crisp

recipes.name: Sambal telur
steps: Boil eggs 9 minutes, peel and fry until blistered
Blend soaked chili, shallots and garlic, fry until oily
Add tamarind water, sugar, salt and onion rings
Coat the eggs in the sambal

recipes.name: Tauhu goreng kicap
steps: Cut tofu into cubes and fry until golden
Fry garlic, onion and chili
Add both soy sauces and a splash of water
Toss tofu in the sauce, top with spring onion

recipes.name: Sambal tempe ikan bilis
recipes.en: Crispy tempe and anchovies in sweet sambal
steps: Cut tempe into thin sticks, fry with ikan bilis and peanuts until crisp
Fry blended chili, shallots and garlic until oily
Add kicap, sugar and a little tamarind water, reduce until sticky
Toss everything together off the heat

recipes.name: Telur kukus
steps: Beat eggs with 1.5 times their volume of warm water and salt, strain
Steam covered on low heat 12 minutes
Drizzle soy sauce and sesame oil, top with spring onion

recipes.name: Kari dhal
steps: Boil dhal with turmeric in 1 litre water until soft
Add potato, carrot and brinjal, cook 10 minutes
Separately fry onion, garlic, dried chili, curry leaves and curry powder
Pour the tempering into the dhal, add tomato and salt

recipes.name: Kangkung goreng belacan
steps: Pound chili, shallots, garlic, belacan and dried shrimp
Fry the paste on high heat until fragrant
Add kangkung and toss quickly until just wilted

recipes.name: Sawi goreng bawang putih
steps: Fry chopped garlic until light golden
Add sawi stems first, then leaves
Season with oyster sauce and a splash of water

recipes.name: Kubis goreng
recipes.en: Stir-fried cabbage with carrot and egg
steps: Fry garlic, onion and dried shrimp
Add shredded cabbage and carrot
Push aside, scramble the egg, then toss everything with salt

recipes.name: Taugeh goreng ikan masin
steps: Fry diced salted fish until crisp
Add garlic and chili
Add taugeh on high heat, toss 1 minute only

recipes.name: Bayam masak air
steps: Boil 3 cups water with garlic, onion and dried shrimp
Add bayam and cook 2 minutes
Stir in the beaten egg in a thin stream, season

recipes.name: Kacang panjang goreng telur
steps: Fry garlic and onion
Add cut long beans with a splash of water, cook 4 minutes
Add beaten eggs, scramble through, season

recipes.name: Bendi goreng belacan
steps: Pound chili, shallots, belacan and dried shrimp
Fry the paste until fragrant
Add sliced okra, stir-fry 4 minutes

recipes.name: Terung sambal
steps: Cut brinjal and fry until soft, drain
Fry blended chili, shallots, garlic and belacan until oily
Add a little tamarind water and sugar, spoon over the brinjal

recipes.name: Kailan sos tiram
steps: Blanch kailan 1 minute, drain
Fry garlic, add oyster sauce, sugar and a splash of water
Pour the sauce over the kailan

recipes.name: Pak choy sos tiram
steps: Halve pak choy and blanch 1 minute
Fry garlic, add oyster sauce, sesame oil and water
Pour over the pak choy

recipes.name: Sayur campur
steps: Fry garlic, add carrot and cauliflower with a splash of water
Add broccoli and cabbage, cook 3 minutes
Season with oyster sauce, thicken lightly with cornflour

recipes.name: Kubis masak lemak
steps: Pound shallots, chili padi, turmeric and dried shrimp
Boil with 1 cup water
Add cabbage and carrot, then santan. Simmer 5 minutes

recipes.name: Sayur lodeh
steps: Fry cubed tofu until golden
Fry pounded shallots, garlic, turmeric and dried shrimp
Add 1 cup water, carrot and long beans, then cabbage and brinjal
Add santan and tofu, simmer 5 minutes

recipes.name: Brokoli bawang putih
steps: Blanch broccoli 1 minute
Fry plenty of garlic, add broccoli and salt
Splash of cornflour water to coat

recipes.name: Buncis goreng telur
steps: Fry garlic and onion
Add sliced beans and a splash of water, cook 4 minutes
Scramble in the eggs, season

recipes.name: Kubis cina udang kering
steps: Soak and chop dried shrimp
Fry with garlic until fragrant
Add cabbage and a splash of water, cook until just soft

recipes.name: Nasi goreng kampung
steps: Cook the rice ahead and let it cool
Fry ikan bilis until crisp, set aside
Fry pounded shallots, garlic, chili padi and belacan
Add rice, kangkung and soy, toss on high heat. Serve with fried eggs and ikan bilis

recipes.name: Nasi goreng ayam
steps: Cook the rice ahead and let it cool
Fry diced chicken with garlic and onion
Add egg and scramble, then cabbage and carrot
Add rice and sauces, toss on high heat

recipes.name: Mee goreng mamak
steps: Boil and dice the potato, fry tofu cubes
Fry garlic and onion with chili powder
Add eggs, then noodles, sauces, potato and tofu
Add cabbage and taugeh last. Serve with limau kasturi

recipes.name: Bihun goreng
steps: Soak bihun in water 10 minutes, drain
Fry shallots, garlic, chili powder and sliced chicken
Add egg, carrot and cabbage, then bihun and sauces with a little water
Toss in sawi and taugeh until just cooked

recipes.name: Kuetiau goreng
steps: Loosen the kuetiau strands
Fry garlic and prawns on high heat
Add kuetiau and sauces, toss until charred in spots
Push aside, fry eggs, mix in with taugeh and spring onion

recipes.name: Mee sup ayam
steps: Boil chicken with pounded onion, garlic, ginger and soup spice in 2 litres water, 30 minutes
Shred the chicken, season the broth
Blanch noodles, sawi and taugeh
Assemble bowls, top with chicken and spring onion. Chili padi in soy on the side

recipes.name: Nasi lemak
recipes.en: Coconut rice with sambal, egg and anchovies
steps: Cook rice with santan, water, lemongrass, ginger and salt
Fry ikan bilis and peanuts until crisp
Make sambal: fry blended chili, shallots and garlic, add tamarind, sugar and onion rings
Serve with boiled or fried egg and sliced cucumber

recipes.name: Bubur ayam
steps: Boil rice in 2 litres water with ginger, stirring often
Add chicken, simmer 40 minutes until creamy, shred the chicken
Fry sliced shallots and garlic until crisp
Season with salt, white pepper and soy. Top with spring onion and fried shallots

recipes.name: Nasi ayam
steps: Poach the chicken with ginger 35 minutes, keep the broth
Fry garlic, shallots and ginger, add rice, then cook it in the broth
Blend chili, garlic, ginger, lime and a little broth for the sauce
Slice chicken, dress with soy and sesame oil. Serve with cucumber and tomato

recipes.name: Ayam percik
recipes.en: Grilled chicken in spiced coconut gravy
steps: Soak the dried chili in hot water, then blend with the shallots, garlic, ginger and lemongrass
Rub the chicken with the turmeric and a little of the salt
Heat the oil and tumis the paste on low-medium heat
Add the santan, tamarind water, sugar and the rest of the salt. Simmer, stirring, until thick
Grill or pan-sear the chicken, basting with the gravy and turning often
Pour the rest of the gravy over to serve

recipes.name: Ayam goreng kunyit
steps: Pound the garlic to a paste
Rub the chicken with the turmeric, chili powder, salt and garlic. Leave 15 min
Heat the oil in a wok on medium
Fry the chicken in batches, turning once
Drain on paper and serve

recipes.name: Ayam masak sos tiram
steps: Toss the chicken with the cornflour and a spoon of the oyster sauce. Leave 10 min
Heat the oil and fry the chicken until browned
Add the garlic, ginger and onion and stir-fry
Add the rest of the oyster sauce, the dark soy, sugar, salt and half a cup of water. Simmer
Toss in the spring onion and serve

recipes.name: Ayam goreng madu
steps: Season the wings with the salt and pepper and coat lightly in flour
Deep-fry in batches
Pour off the oil and fry the chopped garlic
Add the honey, light soy and oyster sauce and let it bubble
Toss the wings in the glaze and scatter the sesame seeds

recipes.name: Daging masak lada hitam
steps: Slice the beef thinly against the grain and toss with the cornflour
Heat the oil until smoking and sear the beef in 2 batches. Lift out
Fry the garlic and crushed black pepper
Add the onion and capsicum and stir-fry
Put the beef back with the oyster sauce, dark soy, sugar, salt and a third of a cup of water. Toss

recipes.name: Daging masak merah
recipes.en: Beef in spiced tomato chili sauce
steps: Boil the beef pieces in 3 cups of water until tender. Keep the stock
Blend the soaked dried chili with the shallots, garlic and ginger
Heat the oil and fry the cinnamon and star anise
Add the paste and tumis
Add the beef, a cup of the stock, the tomato sauce, sugar and salt. Simmer
Add the sliced onion and tomato wedges and cook 2 min

recipes.name: Ikan bakar air asam
recipes.en: Grilled mackerel with tamarind chili dip
steps: Clean and score the fish, then rub with the turmeric and salt
Toast the belacan in a dry pan
Pound the chili padi with the belacan, then mix with the tamarind water, sliced shallot, chopped tomato, sugar and lime juice
Brush the fish with oil and grill, turning once
Serve with the air asam

recipes.name: Ikan goreng sambal
steps: Rub the fish with the turmeric
Fry the fish in hot oil, turning once. Set aside
Blend the soaked chili with the shallots, garlic and belacan
Pour off all but 4 tbsp oil and tumis the paste
Add the tamarind water, sugar, salt and the sliced onion
Spoon the sambal over the fish

recipes.name: Ikan tiga rasa
recipes.en: Crispy fish in sweet, sour and spicy sauce
steps: Score the fish, rub with salt and dust with flour
Deep-fry until crisp, turning once
Pour off most of the oil and fry the garlic, chili and chili padi
Add the onion and capsicum
Add the tomato sauce, chili sauce, tamarind water, sugar, fish sauce and half a cup of water. Simmer
Pour over the fish

recipes.name: Ikan selar sumbat
steps: Clean the fish and slit along both sides of the backbone to make a pocket
Blend the soaked chili with the shallots, garlic and belacan
Tumis the paste in 3 tbsp of the oil with the sugar
Rub the fish with the turmeric and salt, then fill the pockets with sambal
Shallow-fry the fish in the rest of the oil, turning carefully

recipes.name: Udang masak kicap
steps: Peel and devein the prawns, leaving the tails on
Heat the oil and fry the garlic and shallots
Add the prawns and stir-fry
Add the kicap manis, light soy, sugar, salt and 3 tbsp water
Toss in the sliced chili and onion

recipes.name: Sotong goreng tepung
steps: Clean the squid, cut into rings and pat dry
Mix the flour, cornflour, chili powder, pepper and salt
Dip the rings in beaten egg, then coat in the flour mix
Deep-fry in batches in hot oil
Serve with chili sauce

recipes.name: Sambal kerang
steps: Scrub the cockles, blanch 1 min, then take them out of the shells
Blend the soaked chili with the shallots, garlic and belacan
Heat the oil and tumis the paste
Add the tamarind water, sugar, salt and sliced onion
Stir in the cockles and turn off the heat

recipes.name: Telur masak kicap
steps: Boil the eggs 9 min, cool and peel
Shallow-fry the eggs in the oil, rolling them around
Pour off most of the oil and fry the garlic and onion
Add the kicap manis, dark soy, sugar, salt and half a cup of water
Add the eggs and sliced chili and coat well

recipes.name: Kari telur
steps: Boil the eggs 9 min, cool and peel
Mix the curry powder with a little water
Heat the oil and fry the cinnamon, star anise and curry leaves
Add the onion, garlic and ginger and tumis
Add the curry paste and fry
Add the potato cubes and a cup and a half of water. Simmer
Add the santan, tomato, salt and eggs. Simmer gently

recipes.name: Buncis goreng udang
steps: Slice the beans diagonally
Fry the garlic in the oil
Add the prawns
Add the beans, oyster sauce, salt and 3 tbsp water. Stir-fry

recipes.name: Kobis bunga goreng
steps: Cut the cauliflower into florets and slice the carrot
Fry the garlic in the oil
Add the vegetables and a quarter cup of water. Cover
Add the oyster sauce and salt, then the cornflour mixed with a little water

recipes.name: Acar timun
steps: Cut the cucumber and carrot into sticks; slice the onion and chili
Toss with the salt, leave 10 min, then squeeze dry
Fry the garlic and turmeric in the oil
Add the vinegar and sugar, bring to the boil, then cool
Pour over the vegetables, mix, and top with crushed peanuts

recipes.name: Mee kari
steps: Boil the eggs 9 min and peel; blanch the taugeh and noodles
Blend the shallots, garlic and lemongrass
Tumis the paste with the curry powder in the oil
Add the chicken and 4 cups of water. Simmer
Add the santan, cubed tofu, sugar and salt. Simmer gently
Pour over the noodles and top with egg, chili padi and lime

recipes.name: Nasi tomato
steps: Rub the chicken with the turmeric, chili powder and half the salt
Wash the rice and drain
Fry the onion, garlic, ginger, cinnamon and star anise in the oil
Add the chopped tomato and tomato sauce and cook down
Stir in the rice, milk, the rest of the salt and a cup and a half of water. Cook in the rice cooker or a covered pot
Meanwhile bake or pan-grill the chicken

recipes.name: Bihun sup ayam
steps: Boil the chicken in 6 cups of water with the ginger and soup spice
Fry the sliced shallots and garlic in the oil
Soak the bihun in hot water and drain
Season the stock with the salt and pepper, then blanch the sawi and taugeh in it
Put noodles, greens and chicken in bowls, ladle the soup over, and top with fried shallots and spring onion

recipes.name: Mee hailam
steps: Slice the chicken and carrot; blanch the noodles
Fry the garlic in the oil
Add the chicken and prawns and stir-fry
Add 2 cups of water, the sauces, pepper, salt, carrot and sawi. Boil
Add the noodles, thicken with the cornflour mixed in water, then swirl in the beaten egg

recipes.name: Tom kha gai
steps: Bruise the lemongrass and slice the galangal
Bring the santan and 2 cups of water to a gentle simmer with the lemongrass and galangal
Add the sliced chicken and mushrooms
Add the tomato, fish sauce, sugar, salt and bruised chili padi
Turn off the heat and squeeze in the lime

recipes.name: Pad thai
recipes.en: Thai fried flat noodles with prawns
steps: Mix the tamarind water, fish sauce and sugar into a sauce
Fry the garlic, shallots and diced tofu in the oil
Add the prawns
Push to one side and scramble the eggs
Add the noodles and the sauce and toss
Toss in the taugeh and spring onion. Serve with crushed peanuts, chili powder and lime

recipes.name: Khao pad gai
steps: Use rice cooked a day ahead, or spread fresh rice out to cool
Fry the garlic and onion in the oil
Add the diced chicken
Push aside and scramble the eggs
Add the rice, tomato, fish sauce, light soy and sugar. Toss over high heat
Serve with spring onion, cucumber, lime and chili padi

recipes.name: Pla rad prik
recipes.en: Crispy fish with chili garlic sauce
steps: Score the fish, salt it and dust with cornflour
Deep-fry until crisp
Pound the garlic, chilies and shallots
Fry the paste in 2 tbsp of the oil
Add the tamarind water, fish sauce, sugar and a quarter cup of water. Simmer
Pour over the fish

recipes.name: Kai jeow
steps: Beat the eggs with the fish sauce and 1 tbsp of water
Heat the oil in a wok until smoking
Pour in the eggs from a height
Flip and cook the other side
Top with spring onion and serve with chili sauce

recipes.name: Mapo tofu daging
steps: Mince the beef finely and cube the tofu
Fry the garlic, ginger and chili powder in the oil
Add the beef
Add the chili sauce, soy sauces, sugar, pepper and a cup of water, then the tofu. Simmer
Thicken with the cornflour mixed in water; add the sesame oil and spring onion

recipes.name: Telur goreng tomato
steps: Beat the eggs with a pinch of the salt
Softly scramble the eggs in half the oil and lift out
Fry the tomato wedges in the rest of the oil
Add the ketchup, sugar, salt and a quarter cup of water, then thicken with the cornflour
Fold the eggs back in gently and top with spring onion

recipes.name: Daging brokoli
steps: Slice the beef thinly and toss with half the cornflour
Blanch the broccoli for 1 min
Sear the beef in hot oil and lift out
Fry the garlic and ginger
Add the oyster sauce, dark soy, sugar, salt and half a cup of water; put the beef and broccoli back and thicken with the rest of the cornflour
Drizzle with sesame oil

recipes.name: Ayam stim cendawan
steps: Cut the chicken into pieces and slice the mushrooms and ginger
Mix with the oyster sauce, light soy, sesame oil, cornflour, sugar and pepper. Leave 15 min
Spread on a plate and steam over high heat
Top with spring onion

recipes.name: Ayam teriyaki
steps: Mix the soy, sugar, honey, grated ginger, garlic and 4 tbsp of water
Pan-fry the chicken skin-side down in the oil
Flip and cook the other side
Pour in the sauce and let it bubble, turning the chicken. Thicken with the cornflour if needed
Slice and top with sesame seeds and spring onion

recipes.name: Oyakodon
recipes.en: Japanese chicken and egg rice bowl
steps: Cook the rice
Dissolve the stock cube in a cup of hot water with the soy and sugar
Simmer the sliced onion in the stock
Add the chicken pieces and simmer
Pour in the lightly beaten eggs and cover
Slide over bowls of rice and top with spring onion

recipes.name: Chicken katsu
steps: Butterfly the chicken, pound to an even thickness and season
Coat in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs
Fry in hot oil, turning once
Mix the ketchup, oyster sauce and sugar for the sauce
Slice and serve with finely shredded cabbage

recipes.name: Ayam gochujang
steps: Mix the gochujang, soy, sugar, honey, garlic and ginger
Coat the chicken pieces in half the sauce and leave 15 min
Fry the chicken in the oil
Add the onion, cabbage, the rest of the sauce and a quarter cup of water
Finish with sesame oil, sesame seeds and spring onion

recipes.name: Japchae
recipes.en: Korean glass noodles with beef and vegetables
steps: Soak the sohun, boil 5 min and drain
Blanch the bayam and squeeze dry
Fry the beaten egg into a thin omelette and slice it
Stir-fry the beef strips with the garlic in the oil
Add the carrot, onion and mushroom
Toss everything with the soy, sugar, sesame oil, pepper and seeds

recipes.name: Bibimbap
steps: Cook the rice
Toss the beef strips with the soy, sugar and garlic
Blanch the bayam and taugeh separately and season with sesame oil
Stir-fry the carrot sticks, then the beef, in the oil
Fry the eggs sunny-side up
Top the rice with everything, a spoon of gochujang and sesame seeds. Mix before eating

recipes.name: Spaghetti aglio olio
recipes.en: Garlic and chili spaghetti with prawns
steps: Boil the spaghetti in salted water 1 min less than the packet says. Keep a cup of the pasta water
Gently fry the sliced garlic and chili flakes in the oil
Add the prawns
Toss in the pasta with a splash of the pasta water
Finish with pepper, lemon, spring onion and grated cheese

recipes.name: Spaghetti bolognese
steps: Finely chop the onion, carrot and garlic
Fry them in the oil
Add the minced beef
Add the chopped tomato, ketchup, herbs, sugar, salt, pepper and a cup of water. Simmer
Boil the spaghetti
Serve the sauce on the pasta with grated cheese

recipes.name: Creamy chicken mushroom pasta
recipes.en: Spaghetti in a creamy chicken and mushroom sauce
steps: Boil the spaghetti
Season the chicken strips and fry in the butter. Lift out
Fry the onion, garlic and mushrooms
Stir in the flour, then slowly the milk
Add the cheese, herbs, salt, pepper, the chicken and pasta. Toss

recipes.name: Chicken chop
recipes.en: Chicken chop with black pepper sauce, wedges and coleslaw
steps: Season the thighs with salt and half the pepper and dust with flour
Cut the potatoes into wedges and fry until golden
Pan-fry the chicken skin-side down, then turn
Melt the butter and fry the onion, garlic and the rest of the pepper
Add the oyster sauce, dark soy, sugar, milk and a quarter cup of water. Simmer
Toss the shredded cabbage and carrot with the vinegar for the coleslaw, and serve everything together

recipes.name: Fish and chips
recipes.en: Battered fish with chips and slaw
steps: Cut the potatoes into thick chips, soak 10 min and pat dry
Fry the chips until soft but pale. Lift out
Whisk the flour, cornflour, egg, salt, pepper and cold water into a batter
Dip the fish pieces in batter and fry
Fry the chips again
Serve with lemon and a quick slaw of cabbage, vinegar and sugar

recipes.name: Shepherd's pie
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender
Fry the onion, carrot and garlic in the oil
Add the minced beef
Stir in the flour, then the ketchup, soy, stock cube, herbs and a cup of water. Simmer
Mash the potatoes with the butter, milk, salt and pepper
Spread the mash over the beef, top with cheese and bake at 200°C

recipes.name: Lemon butter fish
recipes.en: Pan-fried fish with lemon butter, mash and broccoli
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender
Steam or blanch the broccoli
Season the fish, dust with flour and pan-fry in the oil
Melt the butter with the garlic, then squeeze in the lemon
Mash the potatoes with the milk and some of the lemon butter; spoon the rest over the fish

recipes.name: Chicken stew
steps: Season the chicken and brown it in the butter
Add the onion and garlic
Stir in the flour
Add the potato, carrot, stock cube, herbs, soy and 3 cups of water. Simmer covered
Stir in the milk, salt and pepper

recipes.name: Garlic butter prawns
steps: Peel the prawns, leaving the tails on, pat dry and season
Melt the butter and fry the garlic and chili
Add the prawns
Squeeze in the lemon and top with spring onion

recipes.name: Coleslaw
steps: Finely shred the cabbage, carrot and onion
Whisk the milk, vinegar, sugar, lemon juice, salt and pepper
Toss together and chill 10 min
